original.statement: Inflight request logging now includes extra metadata; no configuration key or operator impact is stated.

consequence.statement: Inflight request log entries carry additional metadata. The evidence does not say that anything fails, is rejected, or behaves differently in a way that needs operator action or review.

corrected.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds extra metadata to inflight request logging (PR 11243). This is an additive logging feature with no operational consequence for an operator.

decision.reason: [ev-06e1c2a72db2] lists this only under Features: extra metadata is added to inflight request logging. Nothing in it says anything fails, changes a default or behaves differently in a way an operator would need to check. Adding fields to log entries has no operational consequence, so the right kind is none (informational), which is also the class both proposers suggested, not behavior-change (review).
